title: Alif: Advancing Urdu Large Language Models via Multilingual Synthetic Data Distillation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance disparity between high-resource and low-resource languages by benchmarking the model on Urdu-translated reasoning and instruction-following datasets (MGSM, AlpacaEval, Dolly General QA) to measure improvements in underrepresented language generation.

Assessing the model's alignment with regional knowledge and cultural nuances via a custom Urdu evaluation set and LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o), alongside human evaluations checking for culturally appropriate idioms rather than literal, western-centric translations.

Evaluated through a custom 'Ethics' subset in the Urdu evaluation set, which tests the model's ability to safely handle or reject prompts containing unethical content, including racism, discrimination, and cultural insensitivity.
